claims: The 2026 The Players Championship is March 12–15.
Golf Channel provides early coverage on Thursday-Friday for the 2026 The Players Championship.
NBC provides afternoon coverage on Saturday-Sunday for the 2026 The Players Championship.
Peacock simulcasts TV coverage for all four rounds of the 2026 The Players Championship.
ESPN+ offers exclusive featured group coverage starting early morning for the 2026 The Players Championship.
ESPN+ offers exclusive featured hole coverage of Nos. 3, 12, 16, 17 starting early morning for the 2026 The Players Championship.
Fubo is an other option for the 2026 The Players Championship.
DIRECTV is an other option for the 2026 The Players Championship.
Xfinity customers can find all coverage on a centralized hub by saying "golf" into their Xfinity voice remote.
